text: {"298":{"about":["rustc_middle"],"refers":[],"why":"rustc_middle interns compiler type representations and allocates them in its type-context arenas."},"299":{"about":["rustc_middle","rustc_arena"],"refers":[],"why":"rustc_middle allocates types through arenas, while rustc_arena implements the underlying buffered arena allocation strategy."},"300":{"about":["rustc_arena"],"refers":[],"why":"Growing an arena by obtaining another allocation buffer is behavior of the arena allocator."},"301":{"about":["rustc_middle"],"refers":[],"why":"rustc_middle's type context and its arenas are parameterized by the compiler lifetime `'tcx`."},"302":{"about":["rustc_middle"],"refers":[],"why":"rustc_middle ties interned type references to `'tcx`, ensuring they cannot outlive the compilation context that owns their arena memory."}}
